title: Are We Rewarding the Wrong Module? Module-Specific Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted to enhance the multimodal reasoning of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods share a common limitation of Module-Level Credit Entanglement, in which the vision encoder, projector, and LLM modules are jointly optimized using the same advantage signals even when perceptual correctness and final-answer correctness differ. To address this limitation, we propose Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), a framework that separates perceptual and outcome-based learning signals across model modules. Specifically, MSPO uses responses to perception checklists comprising auxiliary questions about visual information to derive an advantage for training the vision encoder. translated_title: 我们是否在奖励错误的模块？面向多模态强化学习的模块特定策略优化
translated_abstract: 基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）已被广泛用于增强多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多模态推理能力。然而，现有方法存在一个共同局限——模块级信用纠缠（Module-Level Credit Entanglement），即视觉编码器、投影器和LLM模块使用相同的优势信号进行联合优化，即使感知正确性与最终答案正确性并不一致。为解决这一局限，我们提出了模块特定策略优化（MSPO），这是一个跨模型模块将感知学习信号与基于结果的学习信号相分离的框架。具体而言，MSPO利用针对感知清单（由关于视觉信息的辅助问题组成）的响应来推导用于训练视觉编码器的优势。基于这些响应，MSPO计算置信度感知感知奖励，并使用由此获得的感知符号来……
tldr: 提出模块特定策略优化（MSPO），利用感知清单与置信度感知感知奖励（CaPR）将感知信号与结果信号分离，解决了多模态大语言模型强化学习中的模块级信用纠缠问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Module-Specific Policy Optimization (MSPO), which uses perception checklists and a Confidence-aware Perception Reward (CaPR) to disentangle perceptual from outcome-based learning signals, addressing Module-Level Credit Entanglement in multimodal RL for MLLMs.
